prose: Alphabet's Isomorphic Labs, the Google DeepMind spinout using AI for drug discovery, is in talks to raise about $5 billion at roughly a $50 billion valuation, per Bloomberg sources. It last raised $2.1 billion in May.
highlights: Isomorphic Labs in talks to raise ~$5B at ~$50B valuation
basis: Error cache: Bloomberg paywall/bot-block. Written from the Techmeme headline and lede.
